evidence.observation: O2 rising monotonically during growth from ~5.5 to 39.1 ppm since t=2640, instead of staying at purge-floor levels
Temperature holds 750 °C with stable heater power ~44-46%, so heating control is nominal
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the O2 rise is not from reduced purge flow
Pressure gauge not installed, so a leak cannot be confirmed by pressure; O2 is the only atmosphere channel

args.missing_evidence: Pressure trace (gauge not installed) or an Ar-flow step test: if O2 falls sharply with increased Ar, an air ingress/seal leak is confirmed; also post-run sample characterization.
